location_note: Epigraphic report; Khirbat Umm Leisun south-east of Jerusalem (screen: same site as 'Atiqot 83.7); no map reference. Placed by name in Z4.
notes: Georgian tomb inscription of Bishop Iohane of Purtavi from the crypt under the monastery chapel (24 interments; excavation: Seligman, 'Atiqot 83, not in this reader's units). Crypt coded as context (choice C2); same feature as ATQ83-205. The 'sacred winepress' discussion is etymological; not a feature.

features.subtype: crypt under the monastery chapel with 24 interments; inscribed tomb of Bishop Iohane
features.period: inscription end of the 5th or first half of the 6th c. CE
features.quote: a crypt was discovered under the floor of the monastery chapel
